note: Negatives stay in the official call. The readme calls them blinks. The m-file only special-cases NaN, and its no-saccade branch calls nanmedian, which this Octave statistics package does not implement.
position_columns: first two columns; a third column of 0-3 labels is not passed to the detector
nan_functions: nanmedian and nanvar are local two-line definitions because Octave statistics 1.6.3 does not implement them. checkFixations.m was not edited.
first_pass_note: The first pass rejected 3-column eyeData and MATLAB names truncated to the variable stored in the file. Those trials were rerun. The by_partition means are after that rerun.
